blocks.zh: Section 2: Biological Tests & Packaging System Evaluation | 生物試驗與包裝系統評估
blocks.en: Section 2: Biological Tests & Packaging System Evaluation

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解生物試驗（Biological Tests）在塑料包裝評估中的地位：何時必須進行，何時可以豁免
blocks.en: Understand the role of Biological Tests in the evaluation of plastic packaging: when they are mandatory and when they may be waived

blocks.zh: 區分體外（In Vitro，〈87〉）與體內（In Vivo，〈88〉）生物反應性試驗的方法、終點與適用情境
blocks.en: Distinguish the methods, endpoints and applicable situations of in vitro (<87>) and in vivo (<88>) biological reactivity tests

blocks.zh: 掌握 USP 〈88〉 塑料分類系統（Class I–VI）的判定邏輯與分類依據
blocks.en: Master the decision logic and classification basis of the USP <88> plastics classification system (Class I–VI)

blocks.zh: 理解包裝系統適用性評估（Packaging System Suitability）的三個面向：功能適合性、相容性、安全性
blocks.en: Understand the three aspects of Packaging System Suitability evaluation: functional suitability, compatibility, and safety

blocks.zh: 將 USP 〈661〉 生物試驗要求與 FDA/ICH 對包裝容器密封完整性（CCS integrity）和 E&L 評估的監管期望相連結
blocks.en: Link the USP <661> biological test requirements to the regulatory expectations of FDA/ICH for container-closure system (CCS) integrity and E&L evaluation

blocks.zh: 2.1 Biological Tests — Overview & Regulatory Context | 生物試驗概述與法規背景
blocks.en: 2.1 Biological Tests — Overview & Regulatory Context

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 生物試驗（Biological Tests）的目的：物理化學試驗（Section 1）量化的是萃取物的「量」，而生物試驗評估的是這些萃取物對「生命系統」的影響，即細胞毒性（cytotoxicity）、組織反應性（tissue reactivity）和系統毒性（systemic toxicity）。
blocks.en: Purpose of Biological Tests: The Physicochemical Tests (Section 1) quantify the "amount" of extractables, whereas the Biological Tests assess the effect of these extractables on "living systems", namely cytotoxicity, tissue reactivity and systemic toxicity.

blocks.zh: 即使一個容器通過了物理化學試驗，仍可能含有低濃度但高毒性的物質（如某些殘留催化劑），只有生物試驗才能發現這類問題。
blocks.en: Even if a container passes the Physicochemical Tests, it may still contain low concentrations of highly toxic substances (such as certain residual catalysts); only Biological Tests can detect such problems.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 「必要但不充分」原則：USP 明確指出，生物反應性測試「往往不足以評估監管機構對最終適用性的期望」。這意味著：
blocks.en: The "necessary but not sufficient" principle: USP states explicitly that biological reactivity tests are "often not sufficient to assess the regulatory expectations for final suitability". This means:

blocks.zh: USP 〈87〉/〈88〉 合格 = 基礎門檻（baseline），不是終點
blocks.en: Passing USP <87>/<88> = a baseline, not the end point

blocks.zh: 對於注射劑、吸入劑等高風險產品，監管機構（FDA、EMA）通常還要求完整的 E&L 評估
blocks.en: For high-risk products such as injectables and inhalation products, regulators (FDA, EMA) usually also require a full E&L evaluation

blocks.zh: 藥品上市申請（NDA/BLA/MAA）的包裝相容性章節需要超越 USP 〈87〉/〈88〉 的數據支撐
blocks.en: The packaging compatibility section of a marketing application (NDA/BLA/MAA) needs data support that goes beyond USP <87>/<88>

blocks.zh: 「與相應監管機構諮詢」的建議，是 USP 罕見的直接提醒：標準本身不夠，請去找監管機構確認。
blocks.en: The recommendation to "consult with the relevant regulatory authority" is a rare direct reminder from USP: the standard itself is not enough, so go and confirm with the regulators.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 物理化學試驗就像檢查一個廚師的刀具是否生鏽（量化問題）；生物試驗則是讓廚師用這把刀切食材後，測試食材是否對人體有毒性（功能影響）。
blocks.en: Physicochemical Tests are like checking whether a chef's knives are rusty (a quantitative question); Biological Tests are like having the chef cut ingredients with that knife and then testing whether the ingredients are toxic to humans (a functional effect).

blocks.zh: 「生物試驗是必要但不充分的」：就像通過了基礎食品安全測試的廚房，還需要衛生局的現場稽查才能拿到營業執照。USP 〈87〉/〈88〉 是「衛生局測試」，監管機構的具體要求是「營業執照」。
blocks.en: "Biological tests are necessary but not sufficient": it is like a kitchen that has passed the basic food safety test but still needs an on-site inspection by the health authority to get a business license. USP <87>/<88> is the "health department test", and the regulators' specific requirements are the "business license".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一種新型吸入劑使用 PP 容器，需要執行哪些 USP 測試？Physical-Chemical Tests 和 Biological Tests 都需要嗎？
blocks.en: A new inhalation product uses a PP container. Which USP tests are required? Are both Physical-Chemical Tests and Biological Tests needed?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 特別強調生物試驗「往往不足」？這對 CDMO 的 CMC 文件準備有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does USP specifically emphasize that biological tests are "often not sufficient"? What does this mean for a CDMO's preparation of CMC documentation?

blocks.zh: 口服製劑的 PE 容器不需要生物試驗，但如果該口服製劑包含兒科患者（0-2歲），是否應考慮額外的評估？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: PE containers for oral preparations do not require biological tests, but if the oral preparation includes pediatric patients (0-2 years old), should additional evaluation be considered? What is the reason?

blocks.zh: 2.2 Biological Reactivity Tests In Vitro — 〈87〉 | 體外生物反應性試驗
blocks.en: 2.2 Biological Reactivity Tests In Vitro — <87>

blocks.zh: 三種體外細胞毒性試驗的差異：
blocks.en: Differences among the three in vitro cytotoxicity tests:

blocks.zh: Elution Test（溶出試驗）：先製備萃取液，再用萃取液處理細胞。評估的是溶出成分的毒性，對水溶性毒素較靈敏
blocks.en: Elution Test: an extract is prepared first, and the cells are then treated with the extract. It evaluates the toxicity of the eluted components and is more sensitive to water-soluble toxins

blocks.zh: Agar Diffusion Test（瓊脂擴散試驗）：直接接觸法，材料放在細胞上方，毒素通過瓊脂層擴散至細胞。對脂溶性毒素較靈敏（可直接從材料表面釋出）
blocks.en: Agar Diffusion Test: a direct contact method in which the material is placed on top of the cells and toxins diffuse through the agar layer to the cells. It is more sensitive to lipid-soluble toxins (which can be released directly from the material surface)

blocks.zh: MEM Elution Test：使用完整培養基（含血清）作為萃取介質，更接近生理環境，L-929 細胞是 ISO 10993 標準細胞系
blocks.en: MEM Elution Test: uses complete culture medium (containing serum) as the extraction medium, which is closer to the physiological environment; L-929 cells are the standard cell line of ISO 10993

blocks.zh: 三種方法各有優缺點，通常至少需要完成其中一種（依製造商/監管要求選擇）。
blocks.en: Each of the three methods has its own advantages and disadvantages; usually at least one of them must be completed (chosen according to manufacturer/regulatory requirements).

blocks.zh: Elution Test 就像「先把食物浸泡在水中 24 小時，再用這杯水澆花，看花是否枯萎」——間接評估水溶性毒素。
blocks.en: The Elution Test is like "soaking food in water for 24 hours, then watering a flower with that water to see whether the flower wilts" — an indirect assessment of water-soluble toxins.

blocks.zh: Agar Diffusion Test 則像「直接把可疑物品放在花旁邊，看花是否因揮發物或接觸而受影響」——直接接觸評估。
blocks.en: The Agar Diffusion Test is like "placing the suspect item directly next to the flower to see whether the flower is affected by volatiles or contact" — a direct contact assessment.

blocks.zh: Grade 4 反應（>50% 細胞破壞）就像整片花圃全部枯死——材料明顯不適合。Grade 0–2 則像花只是微微打蔫，仍在可接受範圍。
blocks.en: A Grade 4 reaction (>50% cell destruction) is like an entire flower bed dying — the material is clearly unsuitable. Grade 0–2 is like flowers that are only slightly wilted and still within the acceptable range.

blocks.zh: L-929 細胞的意義：L-929 是 NCTC Clone 929 小鼠皮下結締組織細胞，是 ISO 10993（醫療器材生物相容性評估）和 USP 生物試驗的標準細胞系。選用原因：
blocks.en: Significance of L-929 cells: L-929 is the NCTC Clone 929 mouse subcutaneous connective tissue cell line, the standard cell line for ISO 10993 (biological evaluation of medical devices) and USP biological tests. Reasons for choosing it:

blocks.zh: 繁殖穩定，批次間一致性高
blocks.en: Stable proliferation and high batch-to-batch consistency

blocks.zh: 對細胞毒性物質靈敏
blocks.en: Sensitive to cytotoxic substances

blocks.zh: 全球實驗室廣泛使用，數據可比
blocks.en: Widely used in laboratories worldwide, so data are comparable

blocks.zh: 「不符合 = 不適用」：這是 USP 中少有的強制性語言。若體外試驗不通過，該材料在法規層面被視為不適合用於藥品容器，必須更換材料，不能以其他測試「補救」。
blocks.en: "Nonconformance = unsuitable": This is rare mandatory language in USP. If the in vitro test fails, the material is regarded as unsuitable for use in drug containers from a regulatory standpoint; the material must be replaced and cannot be "remedied" by other tests.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的供應商資質評估（Supplier Qualification）中，生物試驗的策略性考量：
blocks.en: Strategic considerations for biological tests in a CDMO's Supplier Qualification:

blocks.zh: 優先向供應商索取 〈87〉 三種試驗的測試報告，確認合格
blocks.en: First request the test reports for the three <87> tests from the supplier and confirm that they pass

blocks.zh: 若供應商僅提供 ISO 10993-5（細胞毒性）報告，需確認使用的細胞株和接受標準與 USP 〈87〉 兼容
blocks.en: If the supplier provides only an ISO 10993-5 (cytotoxicity) report, confirm that the cell line used and the acceptance criteria are compatible with USP <87>

blocks.zh: 對於注射劑，客戶 CMC 文件通常還需要 〈88〉 體內試驗數據（見 Section 2.3）
blocks.en: For injectables, the customer's CMC documentation usually also requires <88> in vivo test data (see Section 2.3)

blocks.zh: 新材料或新製程（如增加 UV 穩定劑）應重新評估生物相容性，不能直接沿用舊材料的測試結果
blocks.en: A new material or new process (such as the addition of a UV stabilizer) should be re-evaluated for biocompatibility; the test results of the old material cannot simply be carried over

blocks.zh: 如果一種塑料在 Elution Test 得到 Grade 2（Mild reactivity），這個材料是否可以用於注射劑容器？說明判斷依據。
blocks.en: If a plastic gives Grade 2 (Mild reactivity) in the Elution Test, can this material be used for injectable containers? Explain the basis for your judgment.

blocks.zh: Agar Diffusion Test 和 Elution Test 各自對哪類毒素更靈敏（水溶性 vs 脂溶性）？為什麼 ISO 10993 建議同時做多種方法？
blocks.en: Which type of toxin is each of the Agar Diffusion Test and the Elution Test more sensitive to (water-soluble vs lipid-soluble)? Why does ISO 10993 recommend performing several methods together?

blocks.zh: 一個材料通過了 USP 〈87〉 體外試驗，但 FDA 在 CMC 審查時要求額外的體內試驗數據，這是否違反「符合 USP = 符合監管要求」的認知？
blocks.en: A material passed the USP <87> in vitro tests, but FDA requested additional in vivo data during CMC review. Does this contradict the belief that "complying with USP = complying with regulatory requirements"?

blocks.zh: 2.3 Biological Reactivity Tests In Vivo — 〈88〉 Classification | 體內生物反應性試驗與塑料分類
blocks.en: 2.3 Biological Reactivity Tests In Vivo — <88> Classification

blocks.zh: USP Plastics Class I–VI 的邏輯：分類越高（Class VI），測試越嚴格，適用範圍越廣。Class VI 是「超級認證」——通過了最嚴格的全套測試，幾乎可以用於任何應用（包括注射劑包裝和長期植入物）。
blocks.en: Logic of USP Plastics Class I–VI: The higher the class (Class VI), the more stringent the testing and the wider the range of application. Class VI is the "super certification": having passed the most stringent complete set of tests, the material can be used for almost any application (including injectable packaging and long-term implants).

blocks.zh: 重要理解：Class VI 不是法規要求，而是材料供應商提供給客戶的「信心保證」。多數藥用注射劑包裝材料應至少達到 Class VI 標準，這也是採購規格中常見的要求（"USP Class VI compliant"）。
blocks.en: Important understanding: Class VI is not a regulatory requirement, but a "confidence assurance" that a material supplier gives to customers. Most packaging materials for pharmaceutical injectables should meet at least the Class VI standard, which is also a common requirement in purchasing specifications ("USP Class VI compliant").

blocks.zh: 體內試驗使用的四種萃取介質 Four Extract Types
blocks.en: Four Extract Types

blocks.zh:
萃取介質    模擬的物質類型    用途
────────────────────────────────────
0.9% NaCl  水溶性、離子性物質  靜脈注射用容器
植物油      脂溶性物質         油性注射劑容器
20% 乙醇   極性有機物          醇性製劑容器
PEG 400    高分子量極性物質    多元醇類製劑

四種萃取介質覆蓋了大多數藥品基質的溶解特性，
確保全面評估各類可萃取物的體內毒性。
blocks.en:
Extraction medium   Type of substance simulated   Use
────────────────────────────────────
0.9% NaCl    Water-soluble, ionic substances    Containers for IV injection
Vegetable oil   Lipid-soluble substances        Containers for oily injectables
20% ethanol  Polar organic substances           Containers for alcoholic preparations
PEG 400      High-molecular-weight polar substances   Polyol-based preparations

The four extraction media cover the solubility characteristics of most drug product matrices,
ensuring a comprehensive assessment of the in vivo toxicity of each type of extractable.

blocks.zh: 體內試驗 vs 體外試驗的定位：
blocks.en: Positioning of in vivo vs in vitro tests:

blocks.zh: 體外（In Vitro，〈87〉）：快速篩選，成本低，不需要動物，是 USP 〈661〉 高風險應用的最低要求
blocks.en: In vitro (<87>): rapid screening, low cost, no animals required; the minimum requirement of USP <661> for high-risk applications

blocks.zh: 體內（In Vivo，〈88〉）：更全面的系統性和局部組織反應評估，Class VI 認定需要完整的體內試驗套組
blocks.en: In vivo (<88>): a more comprehensive assessment of systemic and local tissue reactions; Class VI classification requires the complete set of in vivo tests

blocks.zh: FDA 的 Container Closure System Guidance（2000年）要求注射劑包裝的生物相容性評估應包括體外和體內數據，且 USP 〈87〉/〈88〉 合格是基礎，但監管審查還考量 E&L 研究結果。
blocks.en: FDA's Container Closure System Guidance (2000) requires that the biocompatibility evaluation of injectable packaging include both in vitro and in vivo data; passing USP <87>/<88> is the baseline, but regulatory review also considers the results of E&L studies.

blocks.zh: USP Class I–VI 就像建築材料的耐火等級：Class I 是一般辦公室（低風險），Class VI 是核電站的防護材料（最高風險，最嚴格測試）。
blocks.en: USP Class I–VI is like the fire-resistance ratings of building materials: Class I is an ordinary office (low risk), and Class VI is the protective material of a nuclear power plant (highest risk, most stringent testing).

blocks.zh: 採購藥用包裝容器要求「USP Class VI」，就像建造醫院時要求「最高防火等級材料」——不是法律強制，但是業界最佳實踐，也是客戶/監管機構的預期。
blocks.en: Requiring "USP Class VI" for pharmaceutical packaging containers is like requiring "the highest fire-rated materials" when building a hospital — not mandated by law, but industry best practice and the expectation of customers/regulators.
